title: Western blot analysis of IR fluorescently labelled proteins using the G:BOX Imaging System and the Odyssey Infrared Imaging System.
protocol: Dilute HeLa cell lysate to a concentration ranging from 29.2 - 0.028 µg total protein in 1X LDS sample buffer + 1X sample reducing agent.
Load 10 μl of diluted lysate onto a NuPAGE® Novex® 4-12% Bis-Tris pre-cast SDS-PAGE gel.
Load Precision All Blue marker (2 μl) on to the gel.
Run the gel for 30 minutes at 60V and then increase voltage to 120V until the dye front reaches the bottom (~1 hour 30 minutes).
Wet nitrocellulose membrane in 1X NuPAGE transfer buffer + 10% methanol.
Prepare the transfer stack for the XCell II Blot Module according to manufacturers instructions and transfer proteins for 1 hour 15 minutes at 30V in 1X NuPAGE transfer buffer + 10% methanol.
Remove nitrocellulose membrane from the transfer stack and rinse in PBST.
Block the membrane with Odyssey Blocking Buffer for 1 hour at room temperature with gentle agitation.

Incubate the membrane overnight at 4°C on a rocker with primary antibodies diluted in Odyssey Blocking Buffer + 0.1% Tween (mouse monoclonal anti-actin, 1:5000 and rabbit polyclonal anti-ERK, 1:1000).
Wash the membrane 4 times with PBST, 5 minutes each wash.
Incubate the membrane with secondary antibodies diluted in Odyssey Blocking Buffer + 0.1% Tween for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark with gentle agitation.
Wash the membrane 3 times with PBST, 5 minutes each wash.
Rinse the membrane with PBS alone before scanning or using the imaging system.
Set G:BOX IR<sup>6</sup> system settings for DyLight 680 to Epi Red lighting and Syngene 705M filter with 4x4 binning factor.
Set Odyssey system settings preset for membranes at resolution 169 mm, quality medium, focus offset 0.0, intensity 4.5 for DyLight 680.
Set Odyssey system settings preset for membranes at resolution 169 mm, quality medium, focus offset 0.0, intensity 5 for DyLight 800.
Detect DyLight 680 as red bands and DyLight 800 as green bands using the stated imaging conditions.
Use G:BOX IR<sup>6</sup> and Odyssey imaging system to multiplex between DyLight 680 and DyLight 800 for comparable sensitivity.
Plot the amount of actin and ERK proteins loaded onto the gel against the Integrated Intensity K counts mm² for the Odyssey system using Odyssey software.
Plot the amount of actin and ERK proteins loaded onto the gel against raw volume Signal Intensity for G:BOX IR6 using GeneTools software.
Determine the linear range of DyLight 680 over the series dilution from 7.3-0.22 µg using the Odyssey system.
Determine the linear range of DyLight 680 over the series dilution from 7.3-0.22 µg using G:BOX IR6.
Compare the linearity of data and determine LOD for ERK p44 (DyLight 800) with both Odyssey and G:BOX IR6 systems.
Determine the linear range for ERK p44 with an R² value of 0.98 on the Odyssey system, with a LOD of 0.11 µg.
Determine the linear range for ERK p44 with an R² value of 0.98 on the G:BOX IR6 system, with a LOD of 0.11 µg.
